'''''Thran''-class vessels''' were a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] used by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Two newly-built [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] were assigned to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Fakir sector fleet]] shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The arrival of the ships was reported to [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]] by [[Green squad]] who were monitoring communications from the [[Imperial Communications Center (Iyuta)|Imperial Communications Center]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iyuta]].<ref name="Missing" />
